crossRefs.note: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.
Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before…
Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of…

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.
translations.bsb: Concerning Zebulun he said: “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your journeys, and Issachar, in your tents.
translations.kjv: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.
translations.asv: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; And, Issachar, in thy tents.
